body.name: Complete-run source collection \(\mathcal R(\cdot)\)
body.construction:
From a generic acquired collection \(E_0\), retain one copy of each distinct protocol-mask, label-mask, and labelled-source-mask triple and sort the triples lexicographically.  From a restricted uniform certificate \(E\), do the same for its nonempty factor-ownership records.  From a switching certificate \(E_{\mathrm{sw}}\), do the same for its nonempty branch-ownership records; empty paid-protocol markers contribute no source triple.  In every case the three masks have lengths \(|\mathcal A|\), \(|\mathrm{LIT}|\), and \(|V|(1+|\mathrm{LIT}|)\).  Thus
\[
 N_{\mathrm{src}}=|\mathcal R(\cdot)|
 \bigl(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|+|V|(1+|\mathrm{LIT}|)\bigr)
\]
for the relevant input collection.
